boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's FS_rom.c, 0x0205d94c..0x0205db88: 6 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. Each is identified by its body against pret's pokediamond FS_rom.c. FS_TryLoadTable is instruction for instruction pret's. FSi_InitRom stores the DMA channel and a card lock id, clears the two overlay-table regions, runs CARD_Init and registers the archive as "rom". It then loads the archive from the ROM header's FAT and FNT at 0x027ffe48 and 0x027ffe40. FSi_RomArchiveProc locks the card ROM on command 9 and unlocks it on 10, refuses 1 and leaves the rest to the default. FSi_WriteDummyCallback fails. FSi_ReadRomCallback is an asynchronous card read that returns PROC_ASYNC. FSi_OnRomReadDone ends the archive's command.
Order: mwccarm emits the bodies in reverse, so FS_TryLoadTable, pret's last, is lowest and FSi_OnRomReadDone, pret's first, is highest. The ROM keeps pret's source order reversed.

Older SDK: FSi_InitRom has no multiboot-child branch, so pret's FSi_ReadDummyCallback and FSi_EmptyArchiveProc are absent, and FS_SetArchiveProc runs only after the header check passes. There is no FS_SetDefaultDMA, and FSi_OnRomReadDone does not test CARD_IsPulledOut.
BOTTOM EDGE: FSi_CutFromList (0x0205d920..0x0205d94c) ends the run below. It is not one of pret's FS_rom.c functions.

TOP EDGE: FS_AttachOverlayTable at 0x0205db88, the lowest function of FS_overlay.c (arm9/FS_Overlay). It is in no pret FS_rom.c. It calls FSi_CompareDigest and checks against the digest just below FS_StartOverlay's per-overlay digest table, which places it with FS_overlay.c.
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/FS_Archive: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.

FS_TryLoadTable, FSi_RomArchiveProc, FSi_WriteDummyCallback, FSi_ReadRomCallback and FSi_OnRomReadDone were renamed from their func_ names in this change. symbols/actor_renames.tsv records the evidence. FSi_InitRom kept its name.

Text-only. The data symbols stay in the data link under fs_rom.c's names (fsi_default_dma_no, fsi_card_lock_id, fsi_ovt9, fsi_ovt7, fsi_arc_rom), declared in include/private/fs_rom.h. The "rom" string keeps its address name, data_0209a048.
